SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
